posts.text: Rwanda's proposed F1 circuit: 6km, 17 corners and 197 metres of elevation change across a lap. Wurz and Tilke are designing it around two hills and a lake. The full layout is still to come. https://www.formula1.com/en/latest/article/hills-a-lake-and-a-roller-coaster-inside-rwandas-plan-for-the-african-grand-prix.76LEZDItQYH362QElcHoY1

The FIA's 2027 rules tighten floor-support geometry: a 5mm limit on the rounded junction with bodywork, plus restrictions on where supports can meet it. The changes apply next season. https://www.fia.com/system/files/documents/fia_2027_f1_regulations_-_section_c_technical_-_iss_3_-_2026-10-01.pdf
